title: Orders — what needs my decision today
approval: 2026-01-01 product owner: "I open this every morning to see which orders need me before anything else."

situation: Start of the day: find orders that are blocked on a human decision
A customer calls about one order
notFor: Customers — internal notes and unverified guesses are shown as they are

questions.text: Which orders are waiting on my decision, and what decision?
What constraint or unknown changes that decision (amount, tax, scope)?
Where is a specific order and what happened to it?

nextActions: Approve or reject a waiting order
Search an order by number or customer
success: The first screen shows the waiting orders with the decision each needs
A failed load, an empty list and a truncated list are told apart

information.label: Amount, tax and scope unknowns beside each decision

rules.text: Waiting orders come before the full order list
rules.why: Q1 is why this screen is opened
failures: Completed orders fill the first screen and the two waiting ones are below the fold
checks: waiting orders are listed before all orders

rules.text: Unknown amount, tax or scope is shown beside the approve action, in words, never only in a tooltip
rules.why: Approving without seeing the unknown is the costly mistake
failures: "120 or 1,200 (unit unknown)" summarised into one amount

rules.text: A failed load says failed with a retry; it never shows "no orders"
rules.why: An empty-looking failure makes the manager believe nothing is waiting
checks: failed load is not an empty claim
